verses.greek: Ταῦτα ἐλάλησεν Ἰησοῦς, καὶ ἐπάρας τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν εἶπεν· Πάτερ, ἐλήλυθεν ἡ ὥρα· δόξασόν σου τὸν υἱόν, ἵνα ὁ υἱὸς δοξάσῃ σέ,
verses.literal: These things spoke Jesus and having lifted up the eyes of Him to the heaven He said Father has come the hour do glorify Your the Son that the Son may glorify You.
verses.dgt: Jesus spoke these things, and lifting his eyes to heaven, he said, “Father, the hour has come. Glorify your Son, so that the Son may glorify you,

verses.greek: καθὼς ἔδωκας αὐτῷ ἐξουσίαν πάσης σαρκός, ἵνα πᾶν ὃ δέδωκας αὐτῷ δώσῃ αὐτοῖς ζωὴν αἰώνιον.
verses.literal: Even as You gave to Him authority over all flesh so that all whom You have given to Him He may give to them life eternal.
verses.dgt: just as you gave him authority over all flesh, so that he may give eternal life to all whom you have given him.

verses.greek: αὕτη δέ ἐστιν ἡ αἰώνιος ζωὴ ἵνα γινώσκωσι σὲ τὸν μόνον ἀληθινὸν θεὸν καὶ ὃν ἀπέστειλας Ἰησοῦν Χριστόν.
verses.literal: This now is the eternal life that they may know You the only true God and whom You have sent Jesus Christ.
verses.dgt: And this is eternal life: that they know you, the only true God, and Jesus Christ whom you sent.

verses.greek: ἐγώ σε ἐδόξασα ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς, τὸ ἔργον τελειώσας ὃ δέδωκάς μοι ἵνα ποιήσω·
verses.literal: I myself You glorified on the earth the work having completed that You have given Me that I may do.
verses.dgt: I glorified you on the earth, having completed the work that you gave me to do.

verses.greek: καὶ νῦν δόξασόν με σύ, πάτερ, παρὰ σεαυτῷ τῇ δόξῃ ᾗ εἶχον πρὸ τοῦ τὸν κόσμον εἶναι παρὰ σοί.
verses.literal: And now do glorify Me You yourself Father with Yourself with the glory that I had before the the world existing with You.
verses.dgt: And now, Father, glorify me with yourself with the glory that I had with you before the world existed.

verses.greek: Ἐφανέρωσά σου τὸ ὄνομα τοῖς ἀνθρώποις οὓς ἔδωκάς μοι ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου. σοὶ ἦσαν κἀμοὶ αὐτοὺς ⸁ἔδωκας, καὶ τὸν λόγον σου τετήρηκαν.
verses.literal: I revealed Your the name to the men whom you gave Me out of the world Yours they were and to Me them You gave and the word of You they have kept.
verses.dgt: I revealed your name to the people whom you gave me out of the world. They were yours, and you gave them to me, and they have kept your word.

verses.greek: νῦν ἔγνωκαν ὅτι πάντα ὅσα δέδωκάς μοι παρὰ σοῦ εἰσιν·
verses.literal: Now they have known that all things as much as You have given Me of You are
verses.dgt: Now they have known that everything you have given me is from you,

verses.greek: ὅτι τὰ ῥήματα ἃ ἔδωκάς μοι δέδωκα αὐτοῖς, καὶ αὐτοὶ ἔλαβον καὶ ἔγνωσαν ἀληθῶς ὅτι παρὰ σοῦ ἐξῆλθον, καὶ ἐπίστευσαν ὅτι σύ με ἀπέστειλας.
verses.literal: for the declarations that You gave Me I have given to them and they themselves received them and they knew truly that from You I came forth and they believed that You yourself Me sent.
verses.dgt: because the words that you gave me I have given to them, and they received them and truly knew that I came from you, and they believed that you sent me.

verses.greek: ἐγὼ περὶ αὐτῶν ἐρωτῶ· οὐ περὶ τοῦ κόσμου ἐρωτῶ ἀλλὰ περὶ ὧν δέδωκάς μοι, ὅτι σοί εἰσιν,
verses.literal: I myself concerning them am praying Not concerning the world do I pray but concerning those whom You have given Me for Yours they are
verses.dgt: I ask concerning them. I do not ask concerning the world, but concerning those whom you have given me, because they are yours,

verses.greek: καὶ τὰ ἐμὰ πάντα σά ἐστιν καὶ τὰ σὰ ἐμά, καὶ δεδόξασμαι ἐν αὐτοῖς.
verses.literal: And the things of mine all Yours are and the Yours Mine and I have been glorified in them.
verses.dgt: and all things of mine are yours, and yours are mine, and I have been glorified in them.

verses.greek: καὶ οὐκέτι εἰμὶ ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ, καὶ αὐτοὶ ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ εἰσίν, κἀγὼ πρὸς σὲ ἔρχομαι. πάτερ ἅγιε, τήρησον αὐτοὺς ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί σου ᾧ δέδωκάς μοι, ἵνα ὦσιν ἓν καθὼς ἡμεῖς.
verses.literal: And no longer I am in the world and yet themselves in the world they are and I myself to You am coming. Father Holy do keep them in the name of You which name You have given to Me that they may be one even as we ourselves are.
verses.dgt: And I am no longer in the world, but they are in the world, and I am coming to you. Holy Father, keep them in your name, which you have given me, so that they may be one just as we are.

verses.greek: ὅτε ἤμην μετʼ αὐτῶν ἐγὼ ἐτήρουν αὐτοὺς ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί σου ᾧ δέδωκάς μοι, καὶ ἐφύλαξα, καὶ οὐδεὶς ἐξ αὐτῶν ἀπώλετο εἰ μὴ ὁ υἱὸς τῆς ἀπωλείας, ἵνα ἡ γραφὴ πληρωθῇ.
verses.literal: When I was with them I myself was keeping them in the name of You which name You have given to Me And I guarded them and none of them has perished only except the son the of destruction that the Scripture may be fulfilled.
verses.dgt: When I was with them, I was keeping them in your name, which you have given me, and I guarded them, and none of them perished except the son of destruction, so that the Scripture might be fulfilled.

verses.greek: νῦν δὲ πρὸς σὲ ἔρχομαι, καὶ ταῦτα λαλῶ ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ ἵνα ἔχωσιν τὴν χαρὰν τὴν ἐμὴν πεπληρωμένην ἐν ἑαυτοῖς.
verses.literal: Now however to You I am coming and these things I speak in the world so that they may have the joy the of Mine fulfilled within themselves.
verses.dgt: But now I am coming to you, and I speak these things in the world so that they may have my joy made full in themselves.

verses.greek: ἐγὼ δέδωκα αὐτοῖς τὸν λόγον σου, καὶ ὁ κόσμος ἐμίσησεν αὐτούς, ὅτι οὐκ εἰσὶν ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου καθὼς ἐγὼ οὐκ εἰμὶ ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου.
verses.literal: I myself have given to them the word of You and the world hated them because not they are of the world even as I myself not am of the world.
verses.dgt: I have given them your word, and the world hated them because they are not from the world, just as I am not from the world.

verses.greek: οὐκ ἐρωτῶ ἵνα ἄρῃς αὐτοὺς ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου ἀλλʼ ἵνα τηρήσῃς αὐτοὺς ἐκ τοῦ πονηροῦ.
verses.literal: Not I do ask that You may take them out of the world but that You may keep them from the evil.
verses.dgt: I do not ask that you take them out of the world, but that you keep them from the evil one.

verses.greek: ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου οὐκ εἰσὶν καθὼς ἐγὼ οὐκ εἰμὶ ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου.
verses.literal: Of the world not they are even as I myself not am of the world.
verses.dgt: They are not from the world, just as I am not from the world.

verses.greek: ἁγίασον αὐτοὺς ἐν τῇ ἀληθείᾳ· ὁ λόγος ὁ σὸς ἀλήθειά ἐστιν.
verses.literal: do sanctify them by the truth the word the of You truth is.
verses.dgt: Sanctify them in the truth; your word is truth.

verses.greek: καθὼς ἐμὲ ἀπέστειλας εἰς τὸν κόσμον, κἀγὼ ἀπέστειλα αὐτοὺς εἰς τὸν κόσμον·
verses.literal: Even as Me myself You sent into the world I myself also sent them into the world.
verses.dgt: Just as you sent me into the world, I also sent them into the world.

verses.greek: καὶ ὑπὲρ αὐτῶν ἐγὼ ἁγιάζω ἐμαυτόν, ἵνα ὦσιν καὶ αὐτοὶ ἡγιασμένοι ἐν ἀληθείᾳ.
verses.literal: and for them I myself sanctify Myself that may be also they themselves sanctified in truth.
verses.dgt: And for their sake I sanctify myself, so that they also may be sanctified in truth.

verses.greek: Οὐ περὶ τούτων δὲ ἐρωτῶ μόνον, ἀλλὰ καὶ περὶ τῶν πιστευόντων διὰ τοῦ λόγου αὐτῶν εἰς ἐμέ,
verses.literal: Not for these however do I ask only but also for those are believing through the word of them in Me myself
verses.dgt: I do not ask concerning these only, but also concerning those who believe in me through their word,

verses.greek: ἵνα πάντες ἓν ὦσιν, καθὼς σύ, πάτερ, ἐν ἐμοὶ κἀγὼ ἐν σοί, ἵνα καὶ αὐτοὶ ἐν ἡμῖν ὦσιν, ἵνα ὁ κόσμος πιστεύῃ ὅτι σύ με ἀπέστειλας.
verses.literal: that all one may be even as You yourself Father are in Me myself and I myself in You that also they themselves in Us may be that the world may believe that You yourself Me sent.
verses.dgt: so that they all may be one, just as you, Father, are in me and I in you, so that they also may be in us, so that the world may believe that you sent me.

verses.greek: κἀγὼ τὴν δόξαν ἣν δέδωκάς μοι δέδωκα αὐτοῖς, ἵνα ὦσιν ἓν καθὼς ἡμεῖς ἕν,
verses.literal: And I myself the glory which You have given Me I have given to them so that they may be one even as We ourselves one —
verses.dgt: And the glory that you have given me I have given them, so that they may be one just as we are one,

verses.greek: ἐγὼ ἐν αὐτοῖς καὶ σὺ ἐν ἐμοί, ἵνα ὦσιν τετελειωμένοι εἰς ἕν, ἵνα γινώσκῃ ὁ κόσμος ὅτι σύ με ἀπέστειλας καὶ ἠγάπησας αὐτοὺς καθὼς ἐμὲ ἠγάπησας.
verses.literal: I myself in them and You in Me myself — that they may be perfected in unity so that may know the world that You yourself Me sent and You loved them even as Me myself You loved.
verses.dgt: I in them and you in me, so that they may be perfected into one, so that the world may know that you sent me and loved them just as you loved me.

verses.greek: πάτερ, ὃ δέδωκάς μοι, θέλω ἵνα ὅπου εἰμὶ ἐγὼ κἀκεῖνοι ὦσιν μετʼ ἐμοῦ, ἵνα θεωρῶσιν τὴν δόξαν τὴν ἐμὴν ἣν δέδωκάς μοι, ὅτι ἠγάπησάς με πρὸ καταβολῆς κόσμου.
verses.literal: Father that one You have given Me I desire that where am I myself they also may be with Me that they may behold the glory the of Mine that You have given Me because You loved Me before the foundation of the world.
verses.dgt: Father, concerning what you have given me, I desire that where I am, they also may be with me, so that they may see my glory that you have given me, because you loved me before the foundation of the world.

verses.greek: Πάτερ δίκαιε, καὶ ὁ κόσμος σε οὐκ ἔγνω, ἐγὼ δέ σε ἔγνων, καὶ οὗτοι ἔγνωσαν ὅτι σύ με ἀπέστειλας,
verses.literal: Father righteous although the world You not has known I myself now You have known and these have known that You yourself Me sent
verses.dgt: Righteous Father, although the world did not know you, I knew you, and these knew that you sent me.

verses.greek: καὶ ἐγνώρισα αὐτοῖς τὸ ὄνομά σου καὶ γνωρίσω, ἵνα ἡ ἀγάπη ἣν ἠγάπησάς με ἐν αὐτοῖς ᾖ κἀγὼ ἐν αὐτοῖς.
verses.literal: And I made known to them the name of You and will make it known so that the love with which You loved Me in them may be and I myself in them.
verses.dgt: And I made your name known to them and will make it known, so that the love with which you loved me may be in them, and I in them.”
